_comment: LANE X — THE PREIMAGE / BINDING SUBJECTS. A subject is one peer-supplied struct, the function that folds its binding preimage, and the files whose adopt paths act on it. NOTHING ELSE IS CURATED: the fields, the adopt functions and the binder names are read off the source, so a field added tomorrow is enumerated tomorrow. Adding a subject here is how this lane grows.

_calibration._comment: The harness's own standard (docs/harness-design.md Part D): a capability is not built until it REPRODUCES a known-missed row. These are the commands that prove it, and they must keep working.

sync_bundle.invariant: I-4 FORK CHOICE INTEGRITY + I-1 — a joiner adopts this struct on the strength of ONE proof, so every field its adopt path acts on must be folded into the accumulator that proof certifies. Rows A3 (blue_work / anchor_blue_work) and A5 (anchor_ordinal) are both this shape, and A5 is the row the hand audit's pins missed.

decider_bundle.invariant: I-4 — the certificate the adopt gate verifies. Its own `chain_acc` is the binding, so the question here is which of ITS fields the accept path acts on without the accumulator covering them.
